# RM brief — G-TECH SECURITY LIMITED (08678041)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- G-TECH Security Limited (company number 08678041) is an active private limited company incorporated on 5 September 2013, some 13 years of trading history, operating under SIC 80200 (security systems service activities). `[profile; computed]`
- The company has a single active director, with four officers appointed at any point in its history and no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- No charges are registered against the company, so it holds a clean security position under SEC-02 and a first-charge facility could be offered subject to the remaining policies. `[SEC-02]`
- Filing conduct is exemplary: every one of the twelve accounts filings on record was submitted ahead of deadline, most recently the year to 30 September 2025 filed on 3 December 2025, some 207 days early. Nothing is currently overdue and the next accounts are not due until 30 June 2027. `[AA filed 2025-12-03; AA filed 2024-12-16; AA filed 2023-11-07; AA filed 2019-06-05; AA filed 2015-05-20; profile]`
- The case is referred under CON-04 because the latest accounts are micro-entity, which do not disclose turnover or profit and so cannot on their own support a serviceability assessment. `[CON-04; AA filed 2025-12-03]`
- Before any decision, obtain management accounts covering the most recent 12 months; the statutory accounts are made up to 30 September 2025, roughly 12 months old as at the review date. `[CON-04; computed; profile]`
